name: Bluey Tunes
overview: Get ready to dance, sing and groove because Bluey Tunes is here! Join Bluey, Bingo, Mum, Dad and friends in a musical adventure filled with fun and dance-worthy beats.  Bluey Tunes is the perfect way to enjoy your favourite Bluey songs like never before. So, turn up the volume, get your body moving and get ready for Bluey Tunes!
